reference: It downloads in seconds; why does sending a video take forever? Many connections have a wide lane down and a narrow lane up. The US broadband benchmark: one hundred megabits down, twenty up. So a hundred-megabyte video downloads in about eight seconds, but uploads in about forty. A text is tiny, so it still slips through. When sending crawls, check your upload speed, not just download. Download Meshline for nearby messaging, even offline.
